# compress_pipeline { #lfpack.compress_pipeline }

```python
compress_pipeline(
    data,
    h=None,
    epsilon=100.0,
    alpha=7.0,
    fs=250.0,
    cadzow_rank=None,
    cadzow_niter=None,
    cadzow_fmax=None,
)
```

Full LFP compression pipeline: Cadzow denoise → SVD-adapt → WP threshold.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default    |
|--------------|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data         | ndarray of shape (nc, ns), float32 | Raw LFP data at *fs* Hz.  Rows are channels, columns are time samples.                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| h            | dict or None                       | Neuropixel probe header containing 'x' and 'y' channel coordinates. Defaults to the first *nc* channels of the NP1 (version 1) geometry. Pass `neuropixel.trace_header(version=2)` for NP2 probes. | `None`     |
| epsilon      | float                              | SVD-adapt threshold multiplier.  Default 100.                                                                                                                                                      | `100.0`    |
| alpha        | float                              | WP threshold multiplier.  Default 7.                                                                                                                                                               | `7.0`      |
| fs           | float                              | LFP sampling rate [Hz].  Default 250.                                                                                                                                                              | `250.0`    |
| cadzow_rank  | int or None                        | Maximum Cadzow rank.  None uses the default for the geometry (5, see `cadzow_lfp_kwargs`).                                                                                                         | `None`     |
| cadzow_niter | int or None                        | Number of Cadzow iterations.  None uses the default for the geometry (1).                                                                                                                          | `None`     |
| cadzow_fmax  | float or None                      | Maximum frequency passed to the Cadzow denoiser [Hz].  None processes all bins (the default for the geometry).                                                                                     | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name          | Type                               | Description                                            |
|---------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| reconstructed | ndarray of shape (nc, ns), float32 | Denoised and compressed–reconstructed LFP.             |
| compressed    | LFPCompressed                      | Compression metadata and per-stage compression ratios. |
